from pathlib import Path

import sys
from pathlib import Path
assert Path('backend/amount.py').read_text() == 'AMOUNT = 1\n'
assert Path('artifact.bin').read_text() in ('export const status = "initial";\n', 'export const status = "draft";\n', 'export const status = "ready";\n')
if Path('artifact.bin').read_text() != 'export const status = "initial";\n':
    assert Path('frontend/banner.js').read_text() == 'export const banner = "welcome";\n'
print('Offline checks passed')
print('Offline independent test diagnostic', file=sys.stderr)
